mapper.select:
select date_format(`bc`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate`, (select `abbreviation` from `base_organization` where `org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id`) as `activeOrgName`, `bc`.`card_number`, (select `name` from `base_patient` where `patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id`) as `cardOwner`, `bc`.`sold_target`, `bc`.`sold_phone_number`, `bc`.`sale_channel_name` as soldChannelName, (select `employee_name` from `base_employee` where `user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id`) as `activeUser` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` where `bc`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `b`.`coupon_type` != 4 and `bc`.`status` in (2,3,4) and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` = 0
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_target` like concat('%', #{soldTarget}, '%')
and `bc`.`sale_channel_id` in
#{item}
and (DATE_FORMAT(`bc`.`active_date`,'%Y-%m-%d') between DATE_FORMAT(#{activeStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{activeEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc

select date_format(`bc`.`sold_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `soldDate`, `bc`.`sold_target`, `bc`.`sold_phone_number`, `b`.`coupon_name`, case when `b`.`coupon_type` = 0 then '代金券' when `b`.`coupon_type` = 1 then '折扣券' when `b`.`coupon_type` = 2 then '兑换券' when `b`.`coupon_type` = 3 then '套餐券' when `b`.`coupon_type` = 4 then '充值卡' else null end as `coupon_type`, `bc`.`card_number`, `b`.`sold_amount`, case when `bc`.`sold_type` = 0 then '售卖' when `bc`.`sold_type` = 1 then '置换' when `bc`.`sold_type` = 2 then '赠送' else null end as `sold_type`, case when `bc`.`charge_status` = 0 then '未收费' when `bc`.`charge_status` = 1 then '已收费' else null end as `charge_status`, `bc`.`pay_name`, `be`.`employee_name` as `sellerUserName` from `base_card` `bc` left join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` left join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `bc`.`seller_user_id` where `bc`.`status` != 0 and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` != 0
and `bc`.`allocate_org_id` = #{orgId}
and (`bc`.`sold_date` >= #{soldStartDate} and `bc`.`sold_date` < date_add(#{soldEndDate}, interval 1 day))
and `b`.`coupon_name` like concat('%', #{couponName}, '%')
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_target` like concat('%', #{soldTarget}, '%')
and `bc`.`sold_phone_number` like concat('%', #{soldPhoneNumber}, '%')
and `b`.`coupon_type` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`sold_date` desc

select `b`.`coupon_name` AS couponName, `bc`.`card_number`, `bo`.`abbreviation` as `rechargeOrgName`, date_format(`bc`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `rechargeDate`, `bp`.`name` as `patientName`, `bp`.`mobile` as `patientMobile`, `bpm`.`card_number` as `rechargeAccount`, `b`.`sold_amount` as `rechargeAmount`, `b`.`bonus` as `rechargeBonus`, `be`.`employee_name` as `rechargeUser` from `base_card` `bc` inner join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` inner join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id` inner join `base_patient_member` `bpm` on `bpm`.`patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id` and `bpm`.type = 1 inner join `base_organization` `bo` on `bo`.`org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id` inner join `base_employee` `be` on `be`.`user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id` where `bc`.`coupon_id` = #{couponId} and `bc`.`status` = 4
and `bc`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{cardNumber}, '%')
and (`bp`.`name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp`.`mobile` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%') or `bp`.`pinyin_name` like concat('%', #{patientKeyWord}, '%'))
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
and `bpm`.`card_number` like concat('%', #{rechargeAccount}, '%')
and (DATE_FORMAT(`bc`.`active_date`,'%Y-%m-%d') between DATE_FORMAT(#{rechargeStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{rechargeEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc
SELECT bc.pay_id as accountItemId, bc.pay_name as accountItemName FROM base_card bc WHERE bc.card_id = #{cardId}

select b.coupon_name as couponName, `bp`.`name` as `patientName`, date_format(`bp`.first_visit_date, '%Y-%m-%d') as firstTreatDate, `bc`.`card_number`, date_format(`bc`.`active_date`, '%Y-%m-%d') as `activeDate`, (select `abbreviation` from `base_organization` where `org_id` = `bc`.`active_org_id`) as `orgName`, (select `employee_name` from `base_employee` where `user_id` = `bc`.`active_user_id`) as `operateUser`, IF(`bc`.`status` in (3, 4), '是', '否') as `used` from `base_card` `bc` left join `base_coupon` `b` on `b`.`coupon_id` = `bc`.`coupon_id` inner join `base_patient` `bp` on `bp`.`patient_id` = `bc`.`patient_id`
and bp.name like concat('%', #{patientKeyword}, '%')
and (DATE_FORMAT(`bc`.`active_date`,'%Y-%m-%d') between DATE_FORMAT(#{activeStartDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{activeEndDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and `bc`.`active_org_id` in
#{item}
and `b`.`coupon_id` in
#{item}
order by `bc`.`active_date` desc

select bc.patient_id, b.coupon_name, bc.card_number, date_format(bc.activation_deadline,'%Y-%m-%d') as activationDeadline, date_format(bc.active_date,'%Y-%m-%d') as activeDate from base_card bc inner join base_coupon b on bc.coupon_id = b.coupon_id
where bc.status = 2 and date_format(date_add(bc.active_date, interval 2 month), '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')
where bc.status in (2,3) and date_format(date_sub(bc.activation_deadline, interval 30 day), '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')
where date_format(date_add(bc.activation_deadline, interval 1 day), '%Y-%m-%d') = date_format(now(), '%Y-%m-%d')

SELECT distinct bo.abbreviation AS orgName, bc.coupon_name AS couponName, bp.name as patName, bbi.bill_num AS billNum, DATE_FORMAT(bbi.bill_date,'%Y-%m-%d') AS billDate, bbi.actual_amount AS orderAmount, bbi.received_amount as actualAmount FROM base_benefit bb LEFT JOIN base_bill bbi ON bb.order_id = bbi.bill_id LEFT JOIN base_patient bp ON bb.patient_id = bp.patient_id LEFT JOIN base_coupon bc ON bb.coupon_id = bc.coupon_id LEFT JOIN base_organization bo ON bb.org_id = bo.org_id
bb.choice_benefit_type = 0 and bb.benefit_type = 1
and (DATE_FORMAT(bbi.bill_date,'%Y-%m-%d') between DATE_FORMAT(#{startDate},'%Y-%m-%d') and DATE_FORMAT(#{endDate},'%Y-%m-%d'))
and bb.coupon_id in
#{couponId}
and bb.org_id in
#{orgId}
order by bbi.bill_date desc
